name: io.github.mollymogi/media-context
title: media-context (mctx)
description: Keep images, video, and audio out of coding agent context windows — local FFmpeg probe/contact-sheet/shrink, offline Whisper transcription, and stateless subscription CLI inspection with automatic quota fallback.

environmentVariables.name: MCTX_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Cooldown duration in seconds after quota/capacity failures (default: 300)
